### He Gives More Grace
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/he-gives-more-grace
Passage: James 4:6
Points:
- Worldly wisdom tempts believers to place their trust in human security instead of God.
- Compromising biblical standards for power, wealth, or acceptance makes one an enemy of the Lord.
- Earthly living and spiritual pride alienate believers from the blessings of God's kingdom.
- The Lord readily offers restoring grace and forgiveness to everyone who repents with a humble heart.

### The Spiritual Cancer
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-may-10-2012.html
Passage: James 4:6
Points:
- Pride acts like a cancer that sabotages relationships and creates distance between people and God.
- Self-absorption and deep insecurity feed an arrogant mindset that demands self-rule.
- Earthly attempts to fix guilt or earn worth are futile and leave people empty.
- Embracing God's lavish grace is the only remedy that dismantles pride and cultivates humility.
